meaning:
Gabriel = "warrior of God" or "man of God"
an archangel; the angel God used to send messages of great importance to man; sent to Daniel, to Zacharias, and to Mary
Also named: Gabriēl (Γαβριήλ "Gabriel" G1043)

elsewhere.note: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”
